layer_definitions.sun_visible_pct_x100_u16_b64: Mean solar disk fraction visible * 100, stored as uint16 LE * 100
layer_definitions.sun_time_pct_x100_u16_b64: % of hours with solar disk fraction > 0, stored as uint16 LE * 100
layer_definitions.earth_visible_pct_x100_u16_b64: % of hours with Earth center above 2m horizon, stored as uint16 LE * 100
layer_definitions.both_visible_pct_x100_u16_b64: % of hours with Sun disk > 0 and Earth visible, stored as uint16 LE * 100
layer_definitions.max_dark_hours_u16_b64: Longest contiguous interval (hours) with solar disk fraction == 0
layer_definitions.slope_deg_x100_u16_b64: Local DEM slope at sampled 240m pixel (deg), stored as uint16 LE * 100
layer_definitions.flat_1km_pct_x100_u16_b64: % of pixels in 9x9 box (~2.16x2.16 km, r~1.08 km) with slope <= 5 deg, stored as uint16 LE * 100
layer_definitions.flat_box_pct_x100_u16_b64: % of pixels in 125x125 box (30x30 km, same as terrain_stats.pct_safe_hls_le_5deg) with slope <= 5 deg, stored as uint16 LE * 100
layer_definitions.elev_m_i16_b64: Surface elevation (m above R0=1737.4 km) at sampled 240m pixel as int16 LE
layer_definitions.sample_pixel_u8_b64: Index dr*5+dc (0..24) of highest 240m pixel in each 5x5 cell
